title: Accepted baseline
description: The build a person accepted for a title, pinned into a run: the newest G4 `pass` decision-record a person gave for the title (or the commit factory.baseline.accepted names), the accepted development commit and the shipped commit, the reports that measured it - copied into the run with their content hashes, pinned by the decision or by the commit they describe - the frames its play captured, copied and checked against their recorded sha256, and the metrics core/reference/accepted-baseline.yaml reads from those reports. `status: none` says why there is no baseline (nothing was accepted yet); `unmeasured` says an accepted build exists that cannot be measured - a regression check on it blocks, never skips. Every later build of the run is held to it by the baseline-regression step (baseline-regression-report). Added in Factory 2.9.0.

status.description: present: an accepted build with its reports. none: nothing was accepted for the title. unmeasured: an accepted build exists that cannot be measured (`problems` says why).

commit.description: The accepted development commit: the decision's pinned prototype-report's.

shipped_commit.description: The commit the decision's qa-report verified.

metrics.description: {metric id: {project: value}} as core/reference/accepted-baseline.yaml `metrics` reads them from the accepted build's reports.
